Name: Robert Wade Bess
Question: Is it disrespectful to tell an atheist ‘Jesus loves you’?
Answer: It doesn't mean enough to me that I would feel disrespected. What you're saying is that a Roman era heretical rabbi cultist (one whom we’re not even sure existed at all) has feelings for me. And that's adorable and all, but not really pertinent to a rational understanding of my place in the grander scheme of things. It makes me sad for you, and more than a little embarrassed on your behalf. Because it's a cringy thing for an adult human being to believe. And if I were to get upset, it would mean that it's as much a matter of consequence to me as it is to you. And it isn't. I don't care. Neither does Jesus. Believe in yourself for a change.

Name: Robert Wade Bess
Question: How do you explain how the rock band Kansas is not in the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame given their influence, talent, and brilliance?
Answer: The idea that anyone would ASPIRE to be recognized by an organization as compromised as the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame is puzzling to me at this point. It's about as prestigious an honor as Mensa membership, or perhaps an MBE. Kansas/Foreigner/Journey/et al are a sort of amalgamation in my mind as far as late 70’s - early 80’s American rock bands go. I think they all should have been inducted together as a single unit. Steve Perry could have delivered a touching speech. Few attendees would have known the difference. Perhaps Kansas should settle for a Dove Award and consider themselves fortunate. (point of know return?)

Question: Is it true that Donald Trump’s VP is very important of this election just in case he is jailed or put in a house arrested or something worse might happen to him? Should Donald Trump pick the outsider? No more career politician.
Answer: No one willing to share a presidential ticket with a convicted felon is qualified to be elected dogcatcher, much less vice-president of the United States of America. And while you can probably tell from my credential that I'm not a big fan of denying felons their rights. …still…god-damned dude. Anybody who'd consider voting for someone like me and some sycophant of mine for the two highest offices in the land is driving around a few quarts low of a full oil pan. That clatter you hear from the MAGA crowd at the rallies isn't applause. It's the sound of knocking valves. Mike Pence may be a simpering church deacon, but at least he wasn't willing to be an accessory to insurrection. That's gonna be a deal breaker for the next guy. Vote like your life depends on it. (‘cause it just might)

Name: Robert Wade Bess
Question: What is typically served for night time meals in US jails/prisons?
Answer: In county, you'd invariably get served entrees which could be baked with institutional grade ovens inside huge stainless steel trays — grub like spaghetti casserole with questionable ground proteins and a crust of yellow processed cheese product, or vast cauldrons of canned sauerkraut with unnaturally red soy based wieners. stuff like that For sides, your tray would have a compartment of watery vegetable medley straight out of the industrial grade can and heated to a simmer in a stew pot on the flattop griddle…maybe a sad mulch of withered iceberg lettuce and cuke rounds with a squeeze packet of generic Ranch in the utensil slot by the plastic spork. …and the inevitable square of cornbread. (god) That wedge of dry and dessicated meal and flour — powdered egg product and pumice stone…. If bread is the staff of life, then jail pone is the billy club Christ used to thump the three card monte dealers from the temple. I don't like instant iced tea, and I don't like powdered fruit drink, but generic Lipton and Kool-Aid were the only refreshment options. The CO’s would wheel the tray trolley along with a couple of those Igloo dispensers into the pod's day room from which you could fill a plastic cup (no ice). I'd sneak into my cell and get tepid tap water from the stainless steel toilet/sink combo to wash the whole mess down with. Basic cable until 11pm lockdown. Headcount and breakfast at daybreak.
